# rixl_bandwidth_usage_history (Data Source)

Returns historical bandwidth consumption timeseries data for capacity planning.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "rixl_bandwidth_usage_history" "history" {
  org_id = var.rixl_org_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `days` (Number) The days query parameter.
- `org_id` (String) The org_id query parameter.

### Read-Only

- `total` (Number)
- `usages` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--usages))
